description: This file defines an interface IndexInitializationConfig which provides configuration settings related to index initialization in a MongoDB context. It also includes an inner enum IndexInitializerConfigValue that outlines known configuration values including their default states, specifically for enabling index initialization.

classes.name: IndexInitializerConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration implementing KnownConfigValue, representing specific configuration values related to index initialization, including a default enabled state.

methods.name: isIndexInitializationConfigEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether index initialization is enabled according to the configuration.
